name: chrome-in-harness
description: Browser MCP: control a real Chrome profile via a MV3 extension bridged to a local MCP server

scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @cic/protocol && npm run dev -w @cic/server
scripts.build:extension: npm run build -w @cic/protocol && npm run build -w @cic/extension
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cic/protocol && npm run build -w @cic/server && npm run build -w @cic/extension
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cic/protocol && npm run test -w @cic/protocol && npm run test -w @cic/server && npm run test -w @cic/extension
